fieldValues.title: Un-bake headings batch B: ext:lifecycle, ext:views-l1, ext:views-l2, ext:themes-l1
fieldValues.summary: Splits 42 baked headings across 4 subsections into 45 mechanism leaves under their concepts (Lifecycle, View x2, Theme), wired by contains/precedes/derived-from, following the #678 procedure. Second of four batches (#684-#687) covering #562s remaining scope.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from srs#580 gate:dispatched queue (dispatch comment 2026-09-08 ~17:20Z on #685, citing the same classification as batch A/#684). Claimed 2026-09-08T17:38Z. Reverse-engineered the exact splitting algorithm from the already-merged #678 diff (its own New leaves table wording is imprecise - it lists the retiring stub itself alongside genuinely new leaves, which reads as if a duplicate-titled leaf were created when in most cases none was): split content on EVERY heading line of any level 1-6 (flattened to siblings, not nested by heading level), one new `mechanism` leaf per heading titled verbatim from the heading text; a substantive pre-heading intro (more than bare **Required for**/**Depends on** metadata tags) gets its own leaf titled after the record; contains from the concept, precedes chained in original order, derived-from back to the retiring subsection, whose content becomes a one-line residual pointer and which otherwise keeps its existing tree position/tags/sourceRefs/children untouched. Re-seeded spec-language-allowlist.json (--seed) since mechanism was already a normativeSites type from #678s RFC-042 Change G - net shrink (596->498) despite 45 new sites, because the old subsections one-line residual content dropped many more stale violations than the new leaves added. Hit a false-positive stale entry on scripts/versioning-cell-allowlist.json from a shallow checkout (git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository -> true) - the same trap finding-07d153cf/unit-08a24109 already documents; git fetch --unshallow before trusting the result, no fix needed once unshallowed, no new finding filed (same lesson, not a second instance).
